summary: CAS losers can retain a local consumption tag and be mistaken for the winner.
A result written before evidence publication is recorded with the wrong failure phase.
The second run-start provenance capture is not rechecked against the exact source lock.
Result and failure blobs are hashed from a second path read.
The documentation still described the already-published V7 lock as pending.
A fresh clone can miss origin-only consumption because failure recovery checks local state first.
The runtime verifier does not bind the annotated source-lock tag object SHA.

required_disposition: Never move, delete, or overwrite the published V7 source-lock tag.
Never publish V7 holdout authorization or consumption tags.
Fix the control plane and publish a new V8 protocol and tag namespace.
